text.tspan: The joint fit has 0.2 to 0.4 points less error than v1 at each

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'C1: error of the median forecast with the fitted solar term, minus the error of the frozen v1 baseline with radiation inputs. September 2023 to June 2026, all daylight half-hours outside logged switching, with oracle sunshine and in-sample capacity, so a ceiling. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole calendar months. Solid rule: no difference. Dashed rule: the 0.35-point threshold for porting.'
text.tspan: C1: error of the median forecast with the fitted solar term, minus the error of the frozen
v1 baseline with radiation inputs. September 2023 to June 2026, all daylight half-hours
outside logged switching, with oracle sunshine and in-sample capacity, so a ceiling. Dot:
estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole calendar months. Solid rule: no
difference. Dashed rule: the 0.35-point threshold for porting.
